highlights: AI models are seeing significant efficiency gains through innovations like boundary-prediction architectures for information extraction and 4-bit quantization techniques that surpass full-precision performance.

The agentic AI landscape is rapidly evolving with new robot foundation models capable of one-shot task learning and critical tools such as field-aware RAG routers and agent-readiness scoring for web services.

Major platforms like OpenAI and Google are enhancing developer offerings with improved model price-performance (GPT-5.6), expanding enterprise AI safety protocols, and launching initiatives for ethical AI governance and literacy.

agents.title: Generalist AI Releases GEN-1.5: A Robot Foundation Model That Learns New Tasks From One 3–12 Second Demo
agents.summary: Generalist AI's GEN-1.5 is a robot foundation model that enables learning new physical tasks from a single 3-12 second sensorimotor demonstration, performing them in-context without fine-tuning or programming, achieving 59% success across diverse manipulation tasks.

agents.title: SchemaRouter: Field-Aware Tool Routing for Efficient Heterogeneous Agentic RAG
agents.summary: SchemaRouter is a lightweight routing layer that optimizes heterogeneous agentic RAG systems by deterministically selecting tools and fields from a schema graph, reducing token usage and latency while improving accuracy and provenance grounding for complex queries.

agents.title: Vercel Introduces ‘Is Agentic’, a Free Agent-Readiness Scoring Tool That Audits Public Websites Using Ora’s 100+ Checks
agents.summary: Vercel and Ora have launched 'Is Agentic,' a free tool providing a readiness score for public websites regarding AI agent interaction, auditing them against 118 checks to help developers optimize their sites for agentic use.

models.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: a compressed, 4-bit model that outperforms its full-precision original
models.summary: This research introduces 'Quantization-Aware Healing,' a technique enabling a compressed 4-bit model to outperform its full-precision counterpart, achieving significant efficiency gains in AI without compromising accuracy.

models.title: Fastino Releases GLiNER2.5: A Boundary-Prediction Architecture That Removes Span Enumeration From Information Extraction
models.summary: Fastino's GLiNER2.5 improves information extraction by replacing span enumeration with boundary prediction, offering CPU-runnable Apache 2.0 checkpoints, joint entity-relation decoding, span attributes, and 4,096-word context for enhanced performance.

models.title: Google Research Introduces ME-POIs: A Mobility-Informed Framework that Adds “How a Place Is Used” to Text-Based POI Embeddings
models.summary: Google Research's ME-POIs framework enriches text-based Point-of-Interest (POI) embeddings by integrating aggregate human movement data, providing insights into a place's usage and significantly boosting performance on map-enrichment tasks.

tools.title: Meet FreeToken: An Edge-Native MoE Serving Engine that Runs 753B GLM-5.2 on a Single Workstation GPU
tools.summary: FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving engine that enables running massive 753B GLM-5.2 models on a single workstation GPU by intelligently managing cache misses, unlocking local deployment of frontier models.

tools.title: KVBoost: Chunk-Level Key-Value Cache Reuse with Deviation-Guided Recomputation for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
tools.summary: KVBoost is a chunk-level KV cache reuse system that significantly accelerates LLM inference by allowing content reuse regardless of position, achieving 4.49x lower time-to-first-token without accuracy loss, and outperforming prefix caching.

tools.title: AIREP: A Protocol for Per-Decision Evidence in AI Runtime Governance
tools.summary: AIREP introduces a new protocol for recording AI runtime governance decisions as signed, verifiable objects, ensuring auditable and tamper-detectable accountability for AI outputs and policy adherence across different systems.

companies.title: Advancing price-performance for developers with GPT‑5.6 in Kiro and Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
companies.summary: OpenAI has made GPT-5.6 available in Kiro, enhancing price-performance for developers in software creation, and partnered with Replit to introduce Free Mode powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, democratizing access to building software.

companies.title: OpenAI Disrupts New Covert Influence Campaign from Russia
companies.summary: OpenAI proactively banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to run a covert influence campaign, demonstrating its commitment to combating malicious AI use and upholding ethical governance standards.

companies.title: IBM Spyre-Accelerated RAG on LinuxONE: Secure, High-Throughput Enterprise AI Inference
companies.summary: IBM introduces a cloud-native RAG architecture on LinuxONE with Spyre accelerators, providing secure, high-throughput enterprise AI inference that keeps sensitive data within a single hardware perimeter, reducing latency up to 20x for regulated industries.

learning.title: The Developer’s Guide to NeMo Guardrails for Enterprise AI Safety
learning.summary: This tutorial provides developers with a guide to implementing production-grade AI safety using the NeMo Guardrails framework, covering layered architectures, PII redaction, retrieval filtering, and policy-based tool gating for LLM applications.

learning.title: Building an End-to-End Document Intelligence Pipeline with deepDoctection
learning.summary: This guide outlines how to construct a complete document intelligence pipeline using deepDoctection, demonstrating configuration of layout analysis, OCR, table extraction, and custom entity recognition for structured JSONL data crucial for RAG workflows.

learning.title: Scientific Data Analysis with LabPlot in Python: Signal Processing, Spectral Peak Fitting, Visualization, and Batch Automation
learning.summary: This tutorial explores a LabPlot-inspired scientific data analysis workflow in Python, focusing on signal processing, Fourier analysis, peak detection, curve integration, visualization, and batch automation using reusable components.
